title: How much can I borrow against commercial property?
description: Loan-to-value caps by property type, a worked serviceability example in dollars, deposit and costs, home equity and super fund borrowing, for Australia.
seo_title: How much can I borrow on commercial property? | Lambton Capital

faq.q: What LVR can I get on commercial property?
faq.a: Many lenders work to roughly 55% to 70% of valuation, depending on property type. Industrial sits at the top of that range and specialised assets such as pubs and service stations at the bottom.

faq.q: Why might I borrow less than the LVR cap allows?
faq.a: Serviceability can bind first. If net rent or business earnings do not cover the interest by a common margin such as 1.75 times, the loan is capped by income, not by the property's value.

faq.q: Can I use my home as security for a commercial purchase?
faq.a: Yes, using home equity is common, but it ties your home to the business loan and raises your effective LVR. Falls in house prices reduce the equity you can use.
